name: variant-annotation-filtering
description: Annotate variants with functional consequence, population frequency, pathogenicity predictions, and clinical significance. VEP (Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor) assigns consequence terms from the Sequence Ontology, predicts protein impact, and adds allele frequencies from gnomAD. ANNOVAR provides alternative annotation with refGene, cytoBand, and multiple prediction databases. Filter variants using GATK VQSR (machine learning on truth sets) or hard filters as fallback.
